objective: 100% native Rust clone of Tessel: same appearance, workflows and behavior. No Electron/Vue application wrapper.
metric_rule: No overall percentage before the reference scenario inventory is complete. Domain certification counts below are audit coverage, not percentage of code written. A passing unit suite or a commit does not certify a domain.
scope_rule: These 20 domains seed the inventory from MIGRATION.md; they are not an exhaustive feature denominator. Preserve all source features and add reference deltas explicitly.
cadence: Update this plan and regenerate the report after each published functional batch.
During active work, report completed work, evidence, remaining gaps and next milestone.
At every active daily checkpoint, revise dates against evidence and record delays. No unattended scheduled execution is configured.
workflow: Focused functional tests and strict all-target Clippy
Matching synthetic Vue/Rust runtime and visual comparison
Publish, record build, update status; reopen on regression

milestones.name: Establish project dashboard, source baseline and acceptance gates
milestones.exit: Versioned tracker, reproducible report, explicit metric and report cadence.

milestones.name: Finish structured SSH forms in GPUI and Compatibility
milestones.exit: Both forms persist all fields; validation, edit/cancel and runtime keyboard tests; source comparison.

milestones.name: Audit the 20 domains into an exhaustive reference-scenario backlog
milestones.exit: Each source feature mapped to scenario, current status, dependency, owner and acceptance command/artifact; then establish global denominator.

milestones.name: First comparable visual/runtime acceptance report
milestones.exit: Synthetic matched captures for shell, settings, Files, terminal and browser; list all differences and remediation tasks.

milestones.name: Close all parity gaps and deliver verified release
milestones.exit: Every reference scenario passes; installer/update/privacy/recovery verified; no open required gap.

schedule_note: Dates M2-M4 are provisional targets, not completion promises. Re-estimate at each checkpoint. Final delivery date remains unestimated until the scenario audit exposes remaining scope and dependencies.

current_work.status: GPUI structured SSH form implemented and focused tests pass. Compatibility form, complete text-input behavior and matched visual/live-server acceptance remain open.
